title: Tsar
html_source:
A tsar is a person appointed by government to advise on and coordinate policy in a particular area, it is also the term for an emperor of Russia. ;-)

The Tsar during the time in which Portrait was published was the last tsar of the Russian empire, Nicholas II. The Russian Revolution of 1917 followed the overthrow of Nicholas II.
